en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small Transylvanian town nestled in a valley with the Carpathian hills in the background. Tiled rooftops, tree‑lined streets, and at least two church towers are visible. The reverse carries a Romanian 40‑bani stamp (European Shooting Championships, 1965), Brasov postmarks, and a printed caption indicating the view. Handwritten Romanian address and message are present.
